maintenance_message: SariMe is temporarily unavailable while we deploy an important system update. All your store products, sales, and utang records are 100% safe on your phone.
maintenance_message_tl: Pansamantalang hindi magagamit ang SariMe habang naglalagay kami ng mahalagang update. Ligtas at buo ang lahat ng iyong paninda, benta, at listahan ng utang sa iyong telepono.

announcement.title: SariMe v1.0.1 Released!
announcement.message: Enjoy new Net Worth Streaks, Activity Logs audit trail, camera photo barcode scanner, printable thermal restock receipts, and refreshed branding!
announcement.message_tl: Tangkilikin ang bagong Net Worth Streaks, talaan ng Activity Logs, photo barcode scanner gamit ang camera, resibo ng panindang bibilhin, at pinagandang disenyo!
